data.description:
# Stop ignoring standups/ so the standup skill can version report history

## Problem

The standup skill (global) auto-commits and pushes each generated daily report so standup history is versioned. It uses a surgical git add of only the report file followed by commit and push.

In this repo standups/ is ignored in two places:

- .gitignore line ~50: standups/ under the comment "Generated daily standup reports (automated artefacts, never committed)"
- .git/info/exclude: a machine-local entry added as a bootstrap until .gitignore lands on dev

Because the path is ignored, git add silently skips the report file and the script's commit becomes a silent no-op — standup history is never versioned. Observed 14th Oct 2026: standups/2026_10_14.md was written but the commit failed with "The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files: standups".

## Background / conflicting prior decision

AH-0MU480XW8009160C (completed, v0.1.4, commit 0cd5984) deliberately added the .gitignore entry to stop generated reports dirtying the working tree, which blocked the implement skill's dirty-tree gate. Since then the standup skill moved to the auto-commit strategy: reports are created once per day and committed immediately, so the tree-cleanliness concern no longer applies to the standalone report files. The skill docs explicitly identify the ignore as a stopgap that makes the commit a silent no-op (SA-0MUDYRHVZ005PQP4).

## Scope

In scope:
- Remove the standups/ entry (and its explanatory comment) from .gitignore.
- Remove the standups/ entry from the machine-local .git/info/exclude.
- Backfill history: commit the existing generated reports already on disk so the versioned standup history starts now.
- Re-run the standup script to confirm the commit-and-push path now works.

Out of scope: changing how/when the standup report is generated; touching other repos' ignore rules.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: standups/ no longer appears in .gitignore or .git/info/exclude.
- [ ] AC2: Existing report files on disk are tracked in git and pushed to dev.
- [ ] AC3: Re-running the standup generator commits and pushes the report (no "paths are ignored" warning).
- [ ] AC4: git status --porcelain is clean after the generator run (no stray dirty state introduced).
- [ ] AC5: All tests pass (npm test).
